What the heck is this?

This is a “map” of all the AI use cases. Similar things cluster together. The broader geographic distribution is meaningless (i.e. east/west/north/south has no meaning).

The colors are VERY NAIVE – just basic keyword matching (or if the agency is NASA). The point of the colors is to show that similar things really do cluster together. The chatbots in purple are all together on the far east. Translation is in green to the northeast.

How to use this?

Just explore! Mouse over different dots and read the use case names. Try different areas – different kinds of AI use will be in different areas.
